scope: Bound DXF CLASS setter staging to the existing parser admission ceiling and refuse rejected class input during CLASS preflight.

behavior: Both const-vector and rvalue setDxfClasses overloads reject more than 65,536 classes before copying or moving caller input.
The const-vector setter copies to a temporary and swaps only after successful allocation; allocation failure marks the pending class input rejected.

Rejected CLASS input causes AC1012+ CLASS preflight to fail, preventing stale class metadata from being serialized. R12 keeps its existing no-CLASSES behavior and retains the metadata for a later target revision.
A later valid setter call clears the rejection state, allowing corrected same-codec preflight retry.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary setter refusal before copy/move, caller/prior-state preservation, corrected same-codec preflight retry, existing CLASS capture limits and proxy CLASS output gate.

limitations: The 65,536 limit is an internal resource ceiling shared with the DXF parser, not a format support claim.
The selector exercises CLASS preflight rather than serializing a full drawing; it does not qualify physical producer coverage or native consumer behavior.
Private dxfRW layout changed; downstream consumers must rebuild, and ABI compatibility remains an open P8 gate.
Other staging/assembly paths, allocation-failure injection, rollback after earlier staged records, source lifetime and platform policy remain open.
next: Continue the safety and caller-state audit on other independently staged metadata and rollback paths.
